BiblicalUsage: Othni was an Israelite, a son of Shemaiah, named once among the gatekeepers of the temple in David's day. He served as a gatekeeper, keeping the doors of the house of God in the days of David.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Othni's one mention is enough to know he was trusted: a gatekeeper of the house of God, set over the threshold.
